theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Adapted for Dark Mode)
theme_and_archetype.mood: Technical, robust, premium, precise, professional engineering.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-bold

rules: Headlines > 32px must use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Labels/Overlines must be uppercase, tiny, and widely spaced.
Never use pure black #000000 or #808080. Base is #0A0A0A.
Color is function only. 95% of UI is monochrome. Accent (#FF2A00) is used sparingly to guide action.
Hover text color must explicitly be set (e.g., hover:text-white).

grid_strategy.marketing: MODE A (Tetris Grid). Asymmetry, visual tension, gap-8 to gap-12. Mix span sizes (col-span-full, col-span-4, col-span-2) to avoid perfect equal squares.
grid_strategy.dashboard: MODE B (Control Room). Strict hierarchy, gap-4 to gap-6. Dense and compact.

surfaces.cards: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). border-collapse style. border-r border-b border-white/10. Flat backgrounds, no soft shadows.
surfaces.header: Crystal Glass variant. bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and delicate 1px border-white/10 on the bottom.

rules: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-8 or p-12) to prevent text collision.
Use subgrid or ensure grid items are direct children of the grid container.
Max image height on mobile is 80vh.

components.strategy: Hybrid: HTML/Tailwind for creative marketing layouts (Hero, Bento Grid), heavily customized Shadcn UI for interactive elements (Forms, Calendar, Dialogs).

specifics.buttons: Sharp corners or max rounded-sm. 1px solid border. Hover states must increase brightness or fill.
specifics.forms: Use Shadcn Input/Textarea/Select. Overwrite default styles to match technical dark mode (bg-[#141414] border-[#262626] focus:border-[#FF2A00]).
specifics.calendar: Shadcn Calendar for appointment booking. Restyle selected day to #FF2A00.
specifics.portfolio_filters: Mono typography tags. Active state gets a 1px border of #FF2A00 and white text.
specifics.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for a dense, technical aesthetic.

interactions_and_animations.hover_states: Crisp transitions. -translate-y-1 on cards with subtle border color shift to #FF2A00.
interactions_and_animations.accessibility: Always respect prefers-reduced-motion. Focus rings must be highly visible (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF2A00] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#0A0A0A]).

rules: All interactive elements must include data-testid.
Format: kebab-case, role-based. Example: data-testid='contact-submit-button', data-testid='portfolio-filter-react'.

media.rules: ONLY use the provided images. Never use placeholders. Use object-cover for all images to maintain layout.

images.description: Abstract neon digital landscape for the main Hero section overlay.
Code on screen - Use for 'Angular & React / C# Java' software projects.
Circuit board macro - Use for 'Arduino Domotics' projects.
Dark mode software UI - Use for full-stack robust systems / dashboard projects.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the frontend using React, TailwindCSS, and Shadcn UI components.
Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', etc. for Headings. Stick to the provided typography.
The Hero Section should use the 'hero_background' image with a bg-black/50 overlay or subtle gradient to ensure text readability.
For the Portfolio Gallery, implement a filter system (e.g., 'All', 'React/Angular', 'Arduino/IoT', 'C#/Java') mapping to the project cards.
The Contact/Appointment section must include an interactive calendar (Shadcn Calendar).
The Admin Dashboard must be in the same Dark Swiss high-contrast theme, implementing CRUD for projects and appointment management views.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
